description.from: Convert live data (~12 MB), verify by rebuilding the old value, cut over with workers paused, deploy the lab stack including the S1 template change. Needs Ryan approval for the change set.
description.to:
One-time script that converts today's ~12 MB of live data into records, verified by rebuilding the old value and comparing, plus the reviewed lab deploy including the S1 bucket-policy and IAM change.
Acceptance: conversion is re-runnable and verified; cutover with workers paused; never-pay-twice and one-worker-at-a-time preserved; explicit approval from Ryan for the change set before deploy. Depends on S2a, S2b, S2c.
